ipCheck.description: Choose whether external services may resolve the server’s public IP addresses.

passwordPolicy.description: Choose password rules and configure recovery emails.
passwordPolicy.existingPasswords: Existing passwords keep working. These rules apply the next time a password is set.

rspamdUi.description: Set the password for the Rspamd web interface.
rspamdUi.serviceFailure: The change could not be confirmed. The new password may take effect at Rspamd’s next start.
rspamdUi.outcomeUnknown: It is unknown whether the password was set. Setting it again is safe.

passwordReset.unavailable: Self-service password reset is unavailable. Set both a sender and a subject to enable it.
passwordReset.defaultsAfterSave: Both templates are empty. The default templates will apply after saving.
passwordReset.missingLink: A template is missing {placeholder}; that version of the email will contain no reset link.
passwordReset.oneEmpty: Only one template is filled in. The email will have only that version.
passwordReset.disableBody: Saving an empty sender or subject stops self-service password reset for every user.

quota.description: Configure mailbox quota warnings and domain copy recipients.
quota.emptyDefaults: Leave empty to restore the default value.
quota.fallback: If Dovecot cannot parse the template, it uses the default template. Empty values restore their defaults after saving.
quota.copies: Configure separate copies for each domain. Each copy includes the mailbox name in its subject.

quotaCopies.empty: Copies stay inactive while the recipient list is empty.
quotaCopies.unavailable: This domain is no longer available. Your changes have not been saved.
